text:
elana: Quick heads-up — need a short cross-team alignment for Customer Delta private pilot. Key asks: dedicated prewarm, HSM/KMS integration, canary rollout w/ fallback to hosted, and a 99.9% latency SLA. Can we map owners, hard blockers, and a feasible runway?

sam: I can own runtime work (prewarm, batching, KV-caching). Quick Q: what's expected peak qps / token profile?

elana: Ballpark: 150–250 qps burst, ~20k tokens/min overall. Cold-start p99 target <150ms. Will confirm with customer but assume business-hour spikes.

tess: From platform/eng side — we can template deployments and rollout policies, but we need KMS access + security signoff before private control plane goes live.

ravi: Security here — KMS/HSM integration needs vendor paperwork + threat model. Plan ~10 business days for review once we get SOW + key access matrix. Also need to lock IAM roles.

juan: Infra note — we have two A100 slots free in the May window, or 4x T4 cheaper but higher p99. Which perf profile do you need? Also we can reserve capacity but need a commit date.

sam: Runtime prefers A100 for latency. We can run quantized 7B on T4 but p99 will suffer ~30% higher. If customer insists on tight latency, A100 reservation required.

elana: Model: 7B SFT fp16, KV cache ~3GB/shard, target 4 shards. Link to spec: https://intra.redwood/specs/customer-delta (placeholder).

tess: Timeline check: if security review starts Mon and infra slots reserved this week, we can pilot in 5 weeks. KMS gating is the critical path.

ravi: Agreed. Action: I'll kick an initial pre-review today — need SOW + network diagram + proposed KMS key policy.

sam: Technical TODOs I'm tracking:
```
prewarm:
  target_qps: 200
  duration_s: 900
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 1024
  max_latency_ms: 50
kv_cache:
  enabled: true
  per_shard_gb: 3
```
I'll open PRs for the batching settings and prewarm job; need infra endpoint + creds.

juan: Action: tentatively reserving 2x A100 from May12-May26 for a pilot. Please confirm by EOD Friday so I can convert to a hard reservation. Also need final image tag and network CIDR.

deploy-bot: calendar: "Delta Pilot Kickoff" created for Thu 10:00 — invite: @elana @sam @juan @tess @ravi.

elana: Summary / action items: 1) elana — finalize customer spec + traffic numbers (by Wed). 2) juan — hold slots; confirm reservation EOD Fri. 3) ravi — run pre-review, request SOW + key policy (start today). 4) sam — open PRs for prewarm/batcher + request creds. 5) tess — schedule infra/runtime sync Thu 10am. If any blocker appears, call it out here. :eyes: :thumbsup:

tess: :thumbsup: scheduling now, will add agenda (KMS gating, rollout plan, fallback policy to hosted).

ravi: Noted. I'll add checklist to the security doc and share link in the meeting.

sam: Thanks — I'll prototype prewarm locally and post perf numbers before the sync.

elana: Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the roadmap doc and notify customer of tentative runway.
